desc.en: Always gives the number it is set to.

desc.zh: 将两个输入相加。数按数计算；图按对应格子计算，数值输入会用于每一格。坐标图保存的是取样位置，相加不会改变图的宽高。
desc.en: Add two inputs. Numbers add directly; images add at matching cells, using a scalar at every cell. Coordinate images store sampling positions. Addition preserves image dimensions.

desc.zh: 在图的 (x, y) 处取值。x、y 是数时取一个像素；是同样大小的坐标图时，每格各取一个，拼成一张同样大小的图。坐标须为整数；出界时按设置报错、取 0 或取最近的边。
desc.en: Reads the image at (x, y). At numbers it reads one pixel; at coordinate images of one size it reads one per cell, an image of that size. Coordinates must be whole numbers; outside the image it stops, reads 0 or reads the nearest edge, as set.
